import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from makemarket.provenance import receipt, file_sha256
from makemarket.scoring import episode_metrics, bootstrap_ci, paired_ratio_ci

path = Path('results/validation/qwen38_sft_seed_dice.json')
assert not path.exists()
plan_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_early_stop_ablation_plan.json')
plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
assert plan['paired_interval_policy']['family_contrasts'] == 10
roots = [Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-primary-sft-validation-v1'), Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-seed1-sft-validation-v1')]
values, hashes, summaries, identities = [], {}, [], []
for training_seed, root in enumerate(roots):
    work = root / 'qwen3.8-27b-sft'
    raw = work / 'results/raw/dice/qwen3.8-27b-sft.jsonl'
    rows = sorted([json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()], key=lambda r:r['seed'])
    assert [r['seed'] for r in rows] == list(range(80000,80100))
    assert all(len(r['rounds']) == 6 and r['game'] == 'dice' for r in rows)
    values.append(np.array([episode_metrics(r)['epnl'] for r in rows]))
    training_root = Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-seed1-training-v1' if training_seed else 'results/kaggle/qwen38-round3-training-v5')
    training_runtime = training_root / 'runtime.json'
    adapter = training_root / 'warmstart_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors'
    assert json.loads(training_runtime.read_text())['seed'] == training_seed
    adapter_hash = file_sha256(adapter)
    assert all(row['provenance']['config']['adapter_sha256'] == adapter_hash for row in rows)
    inference_seeds = {row['provenance']['config']['seed'] for row in rows}
    assert inference_seeds == {0}
    identities.append({'actual_training_seed': training_seed, 'inference_rng_seed': 0, 'training_runtime': str(training_runtime), 'training_runtime_sha256': file_sha256(training_runtime), 'adapter_sha256': adapter_hash})
    scores = work / 'results/leaderboard_dice.json'
    summaries.append(next(r for r in json.loads(scores.read_text())['rows'] if r['player'] == 'qwen3.8-27b-sft'))
    hashes.update({str(p):file_sha256(p) for p in (raw,scores,work/'runtime.json')})
bayes = roots[0] / 'qwen3.8-27b-sft/results/raw/dice/bayes.jsonl'
rows = sorted([json.loads(line) for line in bayes.read_text().splitlines()], key=lambda r:r['seed'])
assert [r['seed'] for r in rows] == list(range(80000,80100))
reference = np.array([episode_metrics(r)['epnl'] for r in rows])
hashes[str(bayes)] = file_sha256(bayes)
delta = values[0] - values[1]
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'registered primary-versus-replication SFT dice validation contrast', 'bootstrap_seed':0, 'family_contrasts':10, 'family_draws':40000}, plan['provenance']['model_revision']),
    'source':Path(__file__).read_text(), 'plan_file':str(plan_path), 'plan_sha256':file_sha256(plan_path),
    'input_sha256':hashes, 'adapter_identities':identities, 'seed_note':'Evaluation config.seed is the inference RNG seed (zero in both jobs). Actual training seed is verified from the saved training runtime and adapter hash; raw provenance is preserved.', 'game':'dice', 'seeds':list(range(80000,80100)),
    'seed0':summaries[0], 'seed1':summaries[1], 'seed0_minus_seed1_expected_pnl':float(delta.mean()),
    'paired_95_ci':bootstrap_ci(delta), 'paired_family_ci':bootstrap_ci(delta,level=.995,n_boot=40000),
    'percentage_point_difference_95':paired_ratio_ci(delta,reference),
    'percentage_point_difference_family':paired_ratio_ci(delta,reference,level=.995,n_boot=40000),
    'interpretation':'Validation only, conditional on these two frozen adapters and response caches. Same early-stopping recipe, different training seeds and selected SFT steps (800 versus 150). Two seeds cannot estimate population training-seed uncertainty. Partial cards cohorts are not scored. Seed one cannot replace the primary test candidate.'}
path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print({k:record[k] for k in ['seed0_minus_seed1_expected_pnl','paired_95_ci','paired_family_ci','percentage_point_difference_family']})
seed_note: Evaluation config.seed is the inference RNG seed (zero in both jobs). Actual training seed is verified from the saved training runtime and adapter hash; raw provenance is preserved.
interpretation: Validation only, conditional on these two frozen adapters and response caches. Same early-stopping recipe, different training seeds and selected SFT steps (800 versus 150). Two seeds cannot estimate population training-seed uncertainty. Partial cards cohorts are not scored. Seed one cannot replace the primary test candidate.
